newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, flat vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, flat vs dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed on Friday at 994-995.10 per mark, firmer than the opening 994-996 due to high foreign currency supply after the lev was pegged under a currency board arrangement launched on Tuesday, dealers said.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as the anchor currency under the IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate system.
* There was increased foreign currency supply while demand from large bidders like fuel and energy importers is traditionally low in the summer, traders said.
* Under the currency board arrangement the central bank pledged to buy and sell an unlimited amount of marks at fixed rates of 995 levs per mark bid and 1,000 levs ask.
* The lev closed at 1,740-1,743 per dollar, little changed from the morning's 1,740-1,744 as traders adjusted levels to the lev/mark rate and the mark/dollar cross on international markets.
